_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see mergeManifestFragments in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it). sections: menu-entry id -> section name. settingsSection: top-level config/definition/admin ids lifted into Nextcloud's settings foldout (NcAppNavigationSettings gear, outside the scrollable nav) — see applySettingsSection in main.js; operational/report/dashboard items (Dashboard, Connections, Automation) stay in the main nav. removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs.

_settingsSectionNote: Promoted into the NC settings foldout (the bottom-left gear, OUTSIDE the scrollable nav) by applySettingsSection in main.js. Settings is the app's configuration page (type:'settings' AppSettings) — genuinely-admin/config, so it lives under the gear rather than as a top-level leaf. The operational surfaces (Dashboard, Connections: Sources/Endpoints/Consumers/Webhooks, Automation: Jobs/Mappings/Rules/Synchronizations/CloudEvents/EventDeliveries) stay top-level. Documentation and FeaturesRoadmap stay in the footer section (help links, not settings).
